message.content:
I don’t have a live API to pull the holiday calendar from, but I can give you a quick rundown of the Canadian federal holidays that create long weekends in 2023. (Note that some holidays are province‑specific; the list below focuses on the nationwide ones that typically generate a three‑day weekend.)

| Date | Holiday | Weekend Impact |
|------|---------|----------------|
| **Feb 20, 2023** | Family Day (Ontario, Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Prince Edward Island) | Monday – long weekend (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) |
| **Apr 7, 2023** | Good Friday | Friday – long weekend (Fri‑Sat‑Sun) |
| **May 22, 2023** | Victoria Day | Monday – long weekend (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) |
| **Sep 4, 2023** | Labour Day | Monday – long weekend (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) |
| **Nov 11, 2023** | Remembrance Day | Monday – long weekend (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) |
| **Dec 25, 2023** | Christmas Day | Monday – long weekend (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) |

If you’re planning trips in provinces that observe additional holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, St. George’s Day in Nova Scotia, etc.), you’ll want to add those as well. This table should give you a solid starting point for your holiday‑planning app.
